# Source and toolchain register

[Project overview](../README.md) · [Documentation](../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Trace the design back to reviewed documents and the exact software revisions used to generate it.

| Record | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [sources.json](sources.json) | Manufacturer/NVIDIA source URLs, review dates and document hashes |
| [toolchain.json](toolchain.json) | KiCad, CadQuery, renderer and pinned cad-agent versions |
| [PINOUT proof](../docs/pinout-proof.md) | Attributed NVIDIA excerpts with provenance |

Vendor archives and full PDFs remain in an ignored local cache. The small pinout excerpts are attributed separately and retain the source owner's rights. See [third-party notices](../THIRD_PARTY.md).

A document hash establishes which source was examined; it does not prove the supplied part or populated carrier matches that document.
